name: OpenCloud
description: Files for a team: folders, sharing, sync clients for desktop and phone, and, with Collabora Online bound, office documents edited in the browser. One Go binary, no database.

env.desc: The admin user's password, set on the first start
Collabora Online's address, like https://office.example.com, to edit office documents (optional)

files.run:
#!/bin/sh
set -e
export OC_CONFIG_DIR="$HOME/data/config" OC_BASE_DATA_PATH="$HOME/data/opencloud"
export OC_URL="https://$SITE_HOST" PROXY_TLS=false PROXY_HTTP_ADDR="127.0.0.1:$PORT" OC_LOG_LEVEL=warn
mkdir -p "$OC_CONFIG_DIR" "$OC_BASE_DATA_PATH"
if [ ! -f "$OC_CONFIG_DIR/opencloud.yaml" ]; then
  ./opencloud init --insecure no --admin-password "$OC_ADMIN_PASSWORD"
fi
if [ -n "$COLLABORA_URL" ]; then
  # the collaboration service speaks WOPI to Collabora on this server; the browser frames Collabora's own address
  export OC_ADD_RUN_SERVICES=collaboration COLLABORATION_APP_NAME=CollaboraOnline COLLABORATION_APP_PRODUCT=Collabora
  export COLLABORATION_APP_ADDR="$COLLABORA_URL" COLLABORATION_WOPI_SRC=http://127.0.0.1:9300 COLLABORATION_HTTP_ADDR=127.0.0.1:9300
  ./csp.sh "$COLLABORA_URL" > "$OC_CONFIG_DIR/csp.yaml"
  export PROXY_CSP_CONFIG_FILE_LOCATION="$OC_CONFIG_DIR/csp.yaml"
fi
exec ./opencloud server
files.csp.sh:
#!/bin/sh
# OpenCloud's content security policy with Collabora's address allowed in frames
cat <<EOF
directives:
  child-src: ["'self'"]
  connect-src: ["'self'", "blob:"]
  default-src: ["'none'"]
  font-src: ["'self'"]
  frame-ancestors: ["'self'"]
  frame-src: ["'self'", "blob:", "$1/"]
  img-src: ["'self'", "data:", "blob:", "$1/"]
  manifest-src: ["'self'"]
  media-src: ["'self'"]
  object-src: ["'self'", "blob:"]
  script-src: ["'self'", "'unsafe-inline'"]
  style-src: ["'self'", "'unsafe-inline'"]
EOF
